title: Zainab pa huva khaatema har ranj-o-balaa ka
body:
Zainab pa huva khaatema har ranj-o-balaa ka
Maatam kiya pehlay toh Rasool-e-doh saraa ka
Phir gham huva darpeish Batool-e-Uzara ka
Dekha sar-e-aaloodh ba-khoon Sher-e-Khuda ka
<<MINI>>
Woh khasthaa jigar Shabbar-e-dilgeer ko royeen
Phir baad-e-Hasan Hazrath-e-Shabbir ko royeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Tiflee hi sey Zainab pah museebath huvi kya kya
Naana kay liye royi kiya maatam-e-Zehra
Aur Mohsin-e-maasoom kay bhi laashey ko dekha
Yeh daagh na bhooli thi kay zakhmi huva baba
<<MINI>>
Tukkdeh jigar-e-Syed-e-masmoom ko dekha
Phir teigh kay neechey Shahey mazloom ko dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Alqissa kay Zainab ko sadaa bhaayi ki thi yaad
Tha dushman-e-Abid jo yazeed-e-sitam eejaad
Guzri yeh qabar usko kay kya bhaitta hai dilshaad
Ijmaah hai shiyoun ka payeh yaari-e-Sajjad
<<MINI>>
Waaris hai woh teigh-e-kamar shair-e-Khuda ka
Ab tujh sey aiwaz leyga woh khoon-e-Shohada ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh sunkay diya hukm shaqi ney sar-e-darbaar
Abid ko giraftaar karein jaakay kuch aswaar
Zanjeer bhi aur tauq bhi bhaari saa ho taiyaar
Lo ab qisaas-e-Shohadaa ka hai talabgaar
<<MINI>>
Kis baat pah magroor woh ibne Shahey deen hai
Kya pehli aseeri ka mazaa yaad nahin hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Baazu mein rasan baandhi thi aur paaoon mein zanjeer
Abid yehi kehthay thay kay kya hai meri taqseer
Woh kehthay thay yaan poocho na aye naaeb-e-Shabbir
Ab Shaam mein ho jaayegi jo honi hai taqdeer
<<MINI>>
Abid ney kaha khair chalo darr mujhey kya hai
Mazloom ka farzand toh raazi ba riza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid ka sukhan koyi bhi khaatir mein na laaya
Naaqey pa usi shakl sey beykas ko bitthaaya
Aur rokay zann-o-mard ney ek shor machaaya
Naagah yeh ek shaqs ney Abid ko sunaaya
<<MINI>>
Kya baittey ho naaqey pa zaraa dekho udhar ko
Hamsheer-e-Hussain aathi hai kholey huvey sar ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Rabb mujhey us shaher ko ab tu na dikhaana
Sar nangay phir us mulk mein mujhko na phiraana
Hai yaad mujhey Shaam ka woh ranj utthaana
Humraah sar-e-Sheh kay huva tha mera aana
<<MINI>>
Ab peish-e-nazar bhaayi ki tasveer nahin hai
Aayi hoon main tanhaa sar-e-Shabbir nahin hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Us raat ko Zainab rahi mashghool-e-munajaat
Naagah saher-e-kooch numayaan huvi haihaath
Sajjad ney Zainab sey yeh ro ro kay kahi baat
Lo bhaayi sey tum apney karo aaj mulaaqaath
<<MINI>>
Kis dard sey kal aap thee mashghool dua mein
Maqbool dua hogayi dargaah-e-Khuda mein
